title: Legacy Forge Buckets
description: Brings back the bucket models used by Forge from 1.8.8-1.11.2!
body:
[![curseforge](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/compact/available/curseforge_46h.png)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/legacy-forge-buckets) [![modrinth](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/compact/available/modrinth_46h.png)](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/legacy-forge-buckets)

---

A small resourcepack for 1.12.2 that brings back the bucket models used by Forge from 1.8.8-1.11.2. This resourcepack requires Forge in order to work.

---

Explicit support for the following:
- All modded fluids and their Forge-generated bucket items!
- [Galacticraft](https://modrinth.com/mod/galacticraft-legacy) bucket items.
- [Tinkers' Complement](https://modrinth.com/mod/tinkers-complement) stone bucket and bucket casts.
